title: SupervisorLogData
description: Log entry sent from a supervisor to the orchestrator via POST /device/logs.

deviceIP.description: IP address of the device sending the log.

funcName.description: Function or subsystem that emitted the log.

loglevel.description: Log level (e.g. INFO, DEBUG, WARN, ERROR).

request_id.description: Optional request ID associated with this log entry.

deployment_id.description: Optional deployment ID associated with this log entry.

module_name.description: Optional module name associated with this log entry.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the log was created on the supervisor.
